svg.title: Quantum control — From circuits to scientific tools.
svg.desc: An original conceptual diagram of the independently developed control stack, with an authentic PCB-layout image from Zhaibin Cui's defense slides. Scripts and an experimental Agent call defined tools through a unified API and protocol; drivers and embedded hardware execute instrument operations. No live data.
svg.text: One control stack. Dozens of instruments. Real experiments.
ACTUAL PCB LAYOUT / ORIGINAL RESEARCH MATERIAL
Typed parameters · device state · structured results
Physical signals · deterministic timing · hardware interlocks
PCB → EMBEDDED → DRIVERS → PROTOCOL → API → EXPERIMENT TOOLS
